mapper.select: SELECT Fm_Date, Fm_Flag, Fm_type, Fm_Code, Fm_GuFlag, Re_name, Fm_Cnt1, Fm_Cnt2, Fm_Cnt3, Fm_Kal, Fm_pro, Sflag, Flag FROM dbo.GetRecipeList(#{searchDate}, 'A') ORDER BY Fm_Flag, Sflag

SELECT cc_Flag = CASE WHEN ISNULL(Do_AM, '0') = '1' THEN '오전' ELSE '오후' END, cc_Code = Do_SaCD, cc_Name = dbo.GetSaNm(Do_SaCD), cc_DeptCD = Ic_PayFlag FROM I_DocOutDuty LEFT JOIN P_InsaCode ON Do_SaCD = Ic_Code WHERE Do_Date = #{searchDate} ORDER BY CASE WHEN ISNULL(Do_AM, '0') = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, Ic_Jikgub
